paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 18:1, reporting in the name of R' Acha.[^1]

notes.text: The heading abbreviates Elazar's title, and the body abbreviates Acha's; both remain R'. ב״ר פ״יח-א is conventionally Bereshit Rabbah18:1, not independently verified against a named edition here.
